---
title: "CHOP test menu collection"
output: html_document
params:
  collect: true
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)
source("R/source.R")
source("R/history.R")
board <- history_board()
result <- if (isTRUE(params$collect)) history_collect(board) else {
  if (!pins::pin_exists(board, history_name("last-attempt"))) stop("No collection status available")
  pins::pin_read(board, history_name("last-attempt"))
}
manifest <- history_manifest(board)
run <- tail(manifest$runs, 1)[[1]]
snapshot <- history_snapshot(board, run)
changed_tests <- length(unique(vapply(run$events, `[[`, "", "test_id")))
app_url <- Sys.getenv("OLSD_APP_URL")
if (nzchar(app_url)) app_url <- paste0(sub("/$", "", app_url), "/?run=", utils::URLencode(run$id, reserved = TRUE))
rmarkdown::output_metadata$set(
  rsc_email_subject = paste("CHOP test menu:", if (run$baseline) "baseline established" else paste(changed_tests, "changed tests")),
  rsc_email_body_text = paste("CHOP test menu:", run$count, "tests collected at", display_time(run$collected_at),
    if (run$baseline) "Initial baseline established." else paste(changed_tests, "changed tests;", run$event_count, "field/status events."),
    if (nzchar(app_url)) paste("Review changes:", app_url) else "See the attached report."),
  rsc_email_suppress_scheduled = !run$baseline && run$event_count == 0
)
```

Collected **`r run$count` tests** at `r display_time(run$collected_at)`.

Run: `r run$id`

```{r provenance, echo=FALSE}
if (identical(snapshot$source_mode, "archive")) {
  cat("Reprocessed retained source pages; this was not a new live website collection. Source capture window:",
      display_time(snapshot$source_window$first), "to", display_time(snapshot$source_window$last), "\n")
}
```

```{r summary, echo=FALSE}
if (run$baseline) {
  cat("Initial baseline established. Future accepted runs will be compared with it.\n")
} else if (!length(run$events)) {
  cat("No changes detected.\n")
} else {
  counts <- table(vapply(run$events, `[[`, "", "type"))
  types <- names(counts)
  tests <- vapply(types, function(type) length(unique(vapply(Filter(function(e) e$type == type, run$events), `[[`, "", "test_id"))), 1L)
  knitr::kable(data.frame(type = types, tests = tests, events = as.integer(counts)))
}
```

```{r link, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nzchar(app_url)) cat("[Review this run in the history application](", app_url, ")\n", sep = "")
```

```{r changes, echo=FALSE}
if (length(run$events)) {
  rows <- lapply(run$events, function(e) data.frame(
    test = e$name, id = e$test_id, type = e$type,
    field = if (is.null(e$field)) "" else e$field
  ))
  knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, rows))
}
```
